name: When should a landlord choose a full remodel over routine turnover repairs?

mainEntity.name: When should a landlord choose a full remodel over routine turnover repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Remodel when your property experiences extended vacancy, falling rental rates, or repeated maintenance calls for aging components. If old laminate countertops are peeling, shower tile grout is failing, or drywall has accumulated layers of patchy repairs, cosmetic updates will no longer suffice. Upgrading prior to marketing the unit helps attract reliable, long-term tenants and justifies market-rate rents. In the greater Denver area, updating outdated 1970s through 1990s interiors with clean finish carpentry, modern tile work, and open kitchen layouts keeps properties competitive with newer builds.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a remodel when components repeatedly fail, rental rates lag behind the local market, or worn finishes prevent you from attracting quality tenants.
